name: model-review
title: Design review working paper
for_each: select id,code from models order by code

sections.title: Scope and review state
sections.note: Internal working paper. Scores and evidence are entered by reviewers. This is not certification that a system is secure.

sections.title: Assessed threats
sections.sql: select code,name,surface,score,owner,due_on,disposition from threat_desk where model_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Review evidence
sections.sql: select revision,actor,evidence,note,next_review from reviews where model_id=$1 order by created_at

name: treatment-plan
title: Threat treatment plan
for_each: select id,code from models order by code

sections.title: Proposed controls
sections.note: Internal working paper. Scores and evidence are entered by reviewers. This is not certification that a system is secure.
sections.sql: select threat_code,code,name,owner,due_on,verified,verifier,evidence from control_desk where model_id=$1 order by threat_code,code

sections.title: Recorded exceptions
sections.sql: select t.code,a.actor,a.reason,a.expires_on,a.evidence from acceptances a join threats t on t.id=a.threat_id where a.model_id=$1 order by a.created_at

name: boundary-register
title: Data flow and boundary register
for_each: select id,code from models order by code

sections.title: Components
sections.note: Internal working paper. Scores and evidence are entered by reviewers. This is not certification that a system is secure.
sections.sql: select c.code,c.name,c.kind,z.name as zone from components c left join zones z on z.id=c.zone_id where c.model_id=$1 order by c.code

sections.title: Data flows
sections.sql: select code,name,source_component,target_component,boundary,protocol,data_description,threats from boundary_desk where model_id=$1 order by code
